name: @unbrowse/node-fetch-shim
description: Drop-in replacement for node-fetch. A safe GET routes through Unbrowse's resolved-route cache first ($0 on hit) and falls straight through to native fetch on miss — same default export, same Headers/Request/Response/FetchError surface, identical semantics.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
